field_docs.fade_time: Seconds a noise event stays alive (the debug ring expands and fades over this time)
field_docs.movement: emit_interval: seconds between footstep noises of a moving soldier; base_radius: metres a walking soldier is heard; armor_radius_per_reduction: extra metres per 1.0 of armor damage_reduction (heavier armor is louder)
field_docs.rings: Debug noise-ring overlay: segments: whole number >= 3 per circle; color_quiet/color_loud as RGBA 0..1, blended by radius; loud_radius: radius in metres that gets the full loud colour
